## 2026-11-05T15:40Z OIDC rejection root cause and fix

- Precise diagnostics in PR #255 showed `generation_activity_delivery=transport-error code=oidc_invalid_url`, not a missing environment. A read-only probe printed the URL components: GitHub now serves the OIDC request endpoint from sharded hosts such as `run-actions-2-azure-eastus.actions.githubusercontent.com`, in addition to `pipelines.actions.githubusercontent.com`. The strict single-host check rejected every token request.
- PR #258 accepts only GitHub-controlled `pipelines` or `run-actions-*` hosts under `actions.githubusercontent.com` and still rejects unrelated domains, credentials and hashes. Offline workflow tests cover both accepted families and three rejected lookalikes. This same defect would have blocked every new-mode operations claim, not just diagnostic activity.
- No token or URL path was logged. The probe printed protocol/hostname only.
